Class ACurve.PendingQueue<T>

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.ACurve.PendingQueue<T>
Type Parameters:
T - pending item payload type (e.g. a point, a sample value, etc.)
Enclosing class:
ACurve
protected static final class ACurve.PendingQueue<T> extends Object
A reusable pending-queue helper for streaming/DAQ scenarios.

Producer threads enqueue items lock-free. Application occurs later on the EDT via drainPendingOnEDT(int, Consumer).

Author:
heddle

      public int drainPendingOnEDT(int max, Consumer<List<T>> applier)
      Drain up to max items on the EDT and apply them in one batch.
      Parameters:
      max - maximum number of items to drain
      applier - called on the EDT with a non-empty batch of items
      Returns:
      number of drained items
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if called off the Swing EDT

    • startDrainTimer

      public void startDrainTimer(int periodMs, int maxPerTick, IntSupplier drainAction, IntConsumer drainedCallback)
      Start a Swing Timer that periodically drains queued items on the EDT.
      Parameters:
      periodMs - timer period in milliseconds; if periodMs <= 0, no timer is started
      maxPerTick - maximum number of items to drain per tick (prevents EDT starvation)
      drainAction - action that performs the drain and returns drained count (EDT)
      drainedCallback - optional callback invoked on the EDT with the drained count

    • stopDrainTimer

      public void stopDrainTimer()
      Stop the drain timer if running.
